gloss: respectfully yours; yours sincerely (formal letter closing)

definitions.explanation: A formal closing phrase used at the end of a letter, paired with the opening {謹啓|きんけい}. More formal than {敬具|けいぐ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{謹啓|きんけい}→謹啓：22309_kinkei⟧…{敬白|けいはく}。
⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{敬白|けいはく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote 'respectfully yours' at the end of the letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{招待状|しょうたいじょう}→招待状：14769_shoutaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{謹啓|きんけい}→謹啓：22309_kinkei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧{敬白|けいはく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧だ。
examples.english: The formal way to write a ceremony invitation is to begin with 'respectfully' and close with 'sincerely yours.'
